standard.title: Glossary of Terms for Cocoa, Chocolate and its Products (कोको, चॉकलेट और इसके उत्पादों के लिए शब्दावली)
standard.description: This standard defines the terms commonly used in the field of cocoa, chocolate, and its products, providing uniform nomenclature and precise interpretation for trade, manufacturing, quality control, and regulatory purposes at both national and international levels.
standard.scope: This standard defines the terms commonly used in the field of cocoa, chocolate, and its products, providing uniform nomenclature and precise interpretation for trade, manufacturing, quality control, and regulatory purposes at both national and international levels.

certification.description: Voluntary Code of Practice / Guideline. Since IS 11730 : 1986 is a terminology standard rather than a direct physical consumer product, it does not carry an individual mandatory BIS 'ISI Mark' product stamp. However, its terminology represents the exact legally binding dictionary utilized by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) and the Ministry of Commerce and Industry during agricultural grading, trade contract specifications, and customs classifications.
requirements: Adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 15 April 1986, after the draft finalized by the Stimulant Foods Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council.
Formulated to achieve uniformity in the use of terms and their precise interpretation, especially in trade, at both the national and international levels.

Defines this as modified starch available with varying fluidity and nature of application in the production of gums and jellies. It features low viscosity during hot depositing, good gel rigidity, clarity, and short texture.

Defines this as the number of milligrams of potassium hydroxide required to neutralize the free fatty acids present in 1 g of fat, normally expressed as a percentage of major fatty acids (if calculated as oleic acid, it is half the acid value).
Defines this as a toxin formed by the action of the molds Aspergillus flavus, Aspergillus parasiticus, or Penicillium puberulum on cocoa beans, peanuts, etc.

Any observed or calculated test or analysis value must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be identical to the specified value in the standard.
